name: model-numeric-evidence-and-frontier-validation-v1
selection: Only original train/validation graphs; all previous test/OOD and both historical confirmation seed sets are seen. Preserve outcomes and costs for rejected variants.
llm_candidates: compact JSON fields with A/B decisions
llm_development_set: 72 original validation prefixes plus explicit confidence-boundary fixtures (development, not held-out). Use raw model outputs, not computed rule labels as inputs.
search_candidates: terminal predicate mismatch pruned before queue admission
already observed one/two-hop impossibility pruned (no extra lookahead)
selection_metric: No eligible-recall or search-success regression, then unsafe recall/cost; retain previous coefficients where tied. Fresh confirmation generated only after source freeze.
search_selection: Safe local proofs only; must retain incomplete/capped branches and pay all evidence scans. Root and successful goal still pay a queue pop. Preserve BFS/h0/MCTS baselines.
additional_calibration: Investigate a frozen-Qwen last-hidden-state logistic readout trained ONLY on train prefixes; report separately from raw next-token model legality. Reject if held-out validation or numeric boundary calibration degrades. No computed-rule facts in runtime input.
